type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Scoped to session rooms, and room-singular, so the key stops here: there is no <target> segment on any room-computers message.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: The PUBLISH instant — when this message went out, ISO-8601 UTC. There is no separate equality stamp: the document is the state, so two publishes compare by content.

RoomComputersCurrentState.description: Ask the room for its computers. Envelope-only — the room's computers are room-singular, so there is nothing to address. The reply is a RoomComputersStateChanged, identical to the broadcast.
